checks.title: Feedback is text, stays until the next submission or view, names its design and is announced
checks.detail: Your design: 1:64 splitter. Too dark at ONT A. ONT A loses 34.2 dB and receives −29.2 dBm. That is 1.2 dB below the dark limit of −28 dBm. This choice usually comes from counting only the fiber and the splitter. Those two alone lose 30.0 dB, which this network could carry. The connectors and splices add 4.2 dB, and that takes ONT A below the dark limit. Next step: look for a design that puts less loss on that path.
